qt: to the Commission Marko Vešligaj (S&D) Subject:

At the meeting of the Committee on Agriculture and Rural Development (AGRI) on 28 September 2026, a Commission representative announced plans to carry out 60 audits in third countries in 2027, focusing on agricultural production and imports. In this context, can the Commission clarify the following: 1.
In which third countries are these 60 audits planned for implementation?
Which agricultural and food products will be included in these audits?

What exactly will the audit process consist of: does the announcement concern enhanced border checks upon import into the EU, or on-the-spot checks performed by the European authorities directly to gauge the production and control capacities of third countries?
